question: What release cadence should this repository run on, and how should out-of-band (mid-week urgent) releases be authorized?
options: Weekly wave, America/Los_Angeles: Monday-Friday is the merge window (closes end of Friday), Saturday is release day (one release PR rolls up pending changesets, owner approves the publish batch once), Sunday is consumer-adoption day, Monday starts fresh. Regular semver (patch/minor/major by changeset level) -- no week-numbered version. A package or week with no pending changesets releases nothing. Out-of-band releases are for security fixes or a broken published release only, as an owner-approved patch (later widened -- see decision below).
CalVer scheme YY.WW.N (ISO week-year/week plus a same-week counter), or 0.YYWW.N (the same, kept pre-1.0).
No fixed cadence; release whenever a change lands.
recommendation: Option 1 (weekly wave, regular semver, owner-approved out-of-band); CalVer considered and rejected during PR #1316's own drafting, per that PR's own account of two owner-directed revisions.
decision: The owner set the calendar directly in a standing-rule comment (#1187 comment 5799538912, 'Standing rule: weekly release calendar (owner direction, 2026-09-23)'): Monday-Friday merge window (closes end of Friday, America/Los_Angeles), Saturday release (one release PR, one owner approval of the publish batch), Sunday consumer adoption (one grouped @clossys/* update PR per consuming repository, a Controller CI convention), Monday starts fresh; regular semver driven by changeset levels, not week-numbered versions; a package with no pending changesets is not released that week, and a week with no changesets anywhere opens no release PR. That same comment states out-of-band releases are for security fixes or a broken published release only, as an owner-approved patch -- later widened by a follow-up owner comment (#1187 comment 5800369031, item 2) to any urgent update the owner approves, on any day, patch by default with `owner-approved: minor` required for a minor bump, major never allowed out of band, and the `release:out-of-band` label applied only by the owner. The owner then signed off on the implementation PR directly: 'Owner sign-off: the owner approved this weekly release calendar (Friday merge cut-off, Saturday release, Sunday consumer adoption, with ad hoc mid-week owner approvals for urgent updates) on 2026-09-23, at head 348e385b, after independent APPROVE (Opus) and RECOMMEND ACCEPT (second reviewer) at that head' (https://github.com/clossys/foundry/pull/1316#issuecomment-5801304853). PR #1316 lands through the merge train carrying this sign-off.
notes: CORRECTED TWICE (#1187 review at 8e6d97ea blocking finding 7, then #1187 review at df15ab87 blocking finding 5). Round 1 found this record claiming PR #1316 was authorized before the owner had signed off, and marked it status: "open" with links.pullRequests emptied. Round 2 found the CALENDAR QUOTE itself misattributed: 'All weekly merges wrap up on a Friday, all releases happen on Saturday, all consumer adoptions happen on Sunday, so every Monday starts fresh' is #1187 comment 5799002037's own text (the release-cadence-in-general rule -- a weekly wave, but with no Friday/Saturday/Sunday specifics in it), and the sentence quoting Friday/Saturday/Sunday together appears verbatim only inside PR #1316's OWN body, in a blockquote citing a DIFFERENT comment -- #1187 comment 5799538912, 'Standing rule: weekly release calendar (owner direction, 2026-09-23)', which is the actual source of the Monday-Friday/Saturday/Sunday/timezone specifics and is cited directly in `decision` above. Since this record's writing, the owner has also directly signed off on PR #1316 itself (comment 5801304853, at head 348e385b, after an independent APPROVE and a RECOMMEND ACCEPT at that head) -- so this record is now status: "decided", decidedBy: "owner", with links.pullRequests: ["1316"] restored. `reviews` above cite the two reviewers' final verdicts at the sign-off head 348e385b directly (5801218972 primary RECOMMEND ACCEPT, 5801170709 secondary Opus APPROVE); the owner's own sign-off comment (5801304853) is the operative authorization and is quoted directly in `decision`, not merely linked.
